data.one_liner: Run ML models on-device or in the cloud with hybrid routing and streaming inference.
data.what_it_does: The Xybrid Flutter SDK lets developers run large language models, text-to-speech, automated speech recognition, and embeddings natively on-device or in the cloud. It features intelligent hybrid routing, streaming inference, model downloading with progress, and conversation context management.
use_when: You need to run LLMs, ASR, or TTS locally on-device without relying on a cloud backend.
You want support for model downloading, progress tracking, and caching.
You need multi-turn conversation memory with automated history management.
avoid_when: Your application targets older platform versions than iOS 16.0, macOS 14.0, or Android API 28.
You want a pure Dart implementation without precompiled native Rust and C++ libraries.
strengths: Runs models completely on-device for privacy and offline usage.
Supports streaming inference, tool calling, and structured JSON schema output.
Handles automatic model downloading, caching, and progress tracking.
weaknesses: Requires high platform minimums (iOS 16.0, macOS 14.0, Android API 28).
First builds require downloading large precompiled native binaries per platform.
data.setup_notes: Requires raising app minimums: minSdk 28 for Android, iOS 16.0 for iOS, and macOS 14.0 for macOS. First builds download precompiled native libraries.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer running TensorFlow Lite models directly on device.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically want a Dart-focused interface for llama models.
